items.exampleEn: The contractor promised to finish the new roof by Friday.
items.exampleZh: 承包商答應在星期五前完成新屋頂。

items.exampleEn: The carpenter made a beautiful wooden table.
items.exampleZh: 木匠做了一張漂亮的木桌。

items.exampleEn: She used plaster to fill the holes in the ceiling.
items.exampleZh: 她用灰泥填補天花板上的洞。

items.exampleEn: The plumbing in our apartment makes strange noises at night.
items.exampleZh: 我們公寓的水管晚上會發出奇怪的聲響。

items.exampleEn: Many people were sad about the demolition of the movie theater.
items.exampleZh: 很多人為電影院被拆除感到難過。

items.exampleEn: The hotel was refurbished before the summer season.
items.exampleZh: 飯店在夏季旺季前重新整修過。

items.exampleEn: He learned carpentry from his grandfather.
items.exampleZh: 他跟爺爺學了木工手藝。

items.exampleEn: Their beach house has a wide verandah that faces the sea.
items.exampleZh: 他們的海邊小屋有一座面海的寬敞門廊。

items.exampleEn: The library is closed for refurbishment until May.
items.exampleZh: 圖書館因為整修，關閉到五月。

items.exampleEn: Smoking is not allowed anywhere on the premises.
items.exampleZh: 本場所內任何地方都禁止吸菸。
items.glossZh: 場所、經營場地；（論證的）前提

items.sentenceEn: A leak in the plumbing flooded the kitchen floor.
items.sentenceZh: 水管漏水，淹了整個廚房地板。

items.audioEn: In summer, we eat dinner out on the verandah.
items.audioZh: 夏天時，我們會到門廊上吃晚餐。
items.questionZh: 夏天他們在哪裡吃晚餐？

items.sentenceEn: A local carpenter fixed the broken stairs.
items.sentenceZh: 當地一位木匠修好了壞掉的樓梯。

items.sentenceEn: The refurbishment of the old station cost millions.
items.sentenceZh: 舊車站的整修工程花了數百萬。

items.stemEn: Water was coming through the ceiling, so we asked someone to check the ____.
items.stemZh: 水從天花板滲下來，所以我們請人來檢查水管。

items.stemEn: The owners plan to ____ the old movie theater and open it again next year.
items.stemZh: 屋主打算翻新那家老電影院，明年重新開幕。

items.passageEn: When my parents bought an old country house, they hired a contractor to refurbish it. The first job was the demolition of a small, broken shed behind the old house. Then workers replaced the old plumbing and covered the cracked walls with fresh plaster. My father, who loves carpentry, built a wooden verandah himself with help from a carpenter friend. The whole refurbishment took eight months and cost much more than they had expected. Now the premises are so attractive that my parents rent two rooms to tourists every summer.
items.passageZh: 我爸媽買下一棟鄉間老房子時，請了一家承包商來翻修。第一項工作是拆除老房子後面一間破舊的小棚子。接著工人換掉舊的水管線路，並用新的灰泥把龜裂的牆面補好。熱愛木工的爸爸在一位木匠朋友的幫忙下，親手做了一座木頭門廊。整個整修工程花了八個月，費用也比預期的高。現在這棟房子漂亮到爸媽每年夏天都會把兩個房間租給觀光客。

questions.questionZh: 整修的第一項工作是什麼？
現在爸媽夏天會做什麼？
options: 把兩個房間租給觀光客

items.promptZh: 那棟老建築下個月就要拆除了。
referenceEn: The demolition of the old building will begin next month.
The old building is due for demolition next month.
rubricZh: demolition 是名詞，表示「拆除」（例如 the demolition of…、be due for demolition 等）
「下個月」可寫，例如 next month、in a month 等

items.promptZh: 這家店把舊手機翻新後再便宜賣出。
referenceEn: This shop refurbishes old phones and sells them at low prices.
The shop refurbishes used phones and then sells them for less.
rubricZh: 「翻新」用 refurbish（例如 refurbishes old phones 等）
「便宜賣出」可寫，例如 sells them at low prices、sells them for less 等
